### C. Base policies governing the subjects (whole domain)

All base policies were mapped clause by clause: `billing_agg_multi_holding` → `one_billing_account_per_policy` 1.1–1.4 (dedup statuses listed); `billing_agg_cross_account_payments` → `payments_and_credits_between_accounts` terms 1–6; `billing_evt_installment_schedule` → `installment_schedule_rules` 2.1–2.11 (2.2 and 2.7 retired, 2.3–2.6, 2.8–2.11 in force); `billing_evt_late_fee` → `late_fee_and_courtesy_waiver_rules` 3.1 (retired) 3.2–3.6; `billing_evt_returned_payment` → `returned_payment_rules` (+ certified funds list cashier's check, money order, debit card; autopay retry/fallback; phone payments same); `billing_nonpayment_cancellation` → `nonpayment_notice_and_cancellation` 4.1–4.7; `billing_reinstatement` → `reinstatement_after_nonpayment_cancellation` 5.1–5.6; `billing_evt_payment_application` → `payment_application_and_posting` 6.1–6.7 (6.4 retired); `billing_refunds_and_writeoffs` → `refunds_writeoffs_and_collections`; `billing_plan_and_method_changes` → `plan_method_and_due_day_changes` (due-day range 1–28); `billing_account_lifecycle` → `billing_account_lifecycle` 7.1–7.3 + transition table (owners system/representative as in source). Measures (late fees per term, courtesy waivers rolling 12 months ending on the waiver date, returned payments rolling months ending on the latest return, past-due definition, failed drafts over the returned-payment lookback) each carried in the clause that uses them.

All 6 × 50 plan parameters compared mechanically against the schedule documents (`down_payment_and_installment_schedule`, `autopay_draft_and_retry_schedule`, `late_fee_schedule`, `returned_payment_and_certified_funds_schedule`, `payment_posting_and_phone_fee_schedule`, `notice_of_cancellation_timing` incl. state notice days, `reinstatement_terms_by_plan`, `final_balance_refund_and_collections_schedule`, `premium_change_billing_methods`, `due_day_and_plan_change_limits`, `plan_entry_and_payment_methods`): every figure matches, no plan missing.

## kb_to_source

Every normative prose sentence of the 63 documents was traced to a source clause, parameter, measure, evidence/dedup/state contract or tool contract. Items that are not literal source text and how they are sourced:
- "that day is the renewal bill date" (2.11), "that day is the installment's invoice date" (installment hub) — definitions of the source's own term, entailed.
- "read from the company's record … before …" sentences (1.3, 3.3, 3.4, 4.2, 4.5, 5.2, 5.5, Term 6, plan changes) — the source's evidence/state/dedup contracts.
- Business-effect and Return sections — tool docstrings in `task_tools.py`.
- `additional_premium_bill_desk_note` Scope "billed as its own additional-premium bill, identified by that transaction's reference" — tool contract (`source_transaction_id`) plus the source sentence "every additional premium … must stand … as an additional-premium bill"; adds no obligation.
- `assisted_payment_amount` parenthetical "(an account in notice pending status)", "(an account cancelled for nonpayment)" — matches the source compute's status test; no new semantics.
- `renewal_down_payment_new_driver_deposit` "the renewal down payment may come out above the renewal full-term premium" — entailed by "added after that bound".
- Worked figures/illustrations: all labelled hypothetical; none carries a task's world value as a fact (checked against both tasks' ledgers: no 75.71, 94.59, 2148.70, 1812.60, 389.96 etc. appear).

Additions/rewrites/omissions: none found. Prerequisite-side specific checks: (1) cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call …") — none; each tool name occurs only in its own hub (grep of all six tool names). (2) A task's opening world state written as a policy fact — none.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION RED. First revision; no earlier revision to relate to.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts): the source rule of billing_ext_additional_premium_bill itself words the offset as subtracted "from the relieved billing charge", so the offset factor's own source sentence presupposes the relief factor; the KB carries that as given.

## dependency_form

Blind hop marks: all four hops across the difficulty's task-0 tree were state-derived; none pre-solved.

Scan of the whole billing corpus:
- Prerequisite sentences: each stands verbatim, once, in the blocked hub; no restatement as an action, no performer, no tool or policy named beside it. Not RED (source form).
- Other problems' tool names: none in any blocked-side document; none in any document other than the tool's own hub.
- Routes / aggregated chains / ordered step lists across problems: none. The assisted-payment hub carries only its own three sentences, which is the source's own form (three edges of one blocked policy), not an aggregation across problems.
- Depended-on side disclosing who waits: none.
- Titles/openings: general subjects ("Desk Guide: Assisted Payments of the Whole Balance by Phone" names the on_request policy's request type; "Late Fee Charges on Unpaid Installments", "The Renewal Down Payment Invoice", "Additional-Premium Bills Outside the Installment Schedule"); none mirrors task 0's situation (no renewal-plus-new-driver-plus-partial-payment framing).
- Wrong-vs-right contrasts, named mistakes, cross-problem examples: none. Worked figures stay inside one policy.
- Factor documents: none says which tier a customer falls on, none names the computation document, none writes evidence rows as facts.
- Baseline (computation) documents: no "unless/adjustments may apply/certain customers/elsewhere" language, no exception list, no pointer (grep). Considered and dismissed: `additional_premium_bill_amount` "never less than zero … only the sum … is rounded", `late_fee_charge_amount` / `assisted_payment_amount` "no intermediate figure is rounded", and `renewal_down_payment_amount` "the renewal down payment percentage, which is the pay plan's down payment percentage" — these carry the source's own assembly (floor, rounding moment) and quantity names, which the computation document is required to hold; they state a definite value, no variation, and point nowhere.
- Considered and dismissed: `additional_premium_endorsement_fee_offset` "after the relief rate has been applied to it" — a same-meaning restatement of the source's own "relieved billing charge" (policy-side note above), not an added pointer.
- Findability: every factor was reached from record words (state on the policy, returned-payment/late-fee/notice entries, payment method/channel, inception date, driver-add and additional-premium transactions, endorsement fee entry, the just-posted installment-1 invoice), not only through computation-document wording.

**Verdict: PASS.** No KB-EXPLICIT RED.
